title: Averages can conceal a slow tenant cohort
method: Synthetic 100-request population: 90×100 ms + 10×1,100 ms = 20,000 ms; divide by 100 for 200 ms. Cohort means do not establish root cause.
alt: Averages can conceal a slow tenant cohort: Fast cohort mean 100 ms, Slow cohort mean 1100 ms, Combined mean 200 ms. Illustrative inputs.
